vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: Ingestion pipeline: file loading, chapter detection, summarization, vector indexing

plan.title: Ingestion Pipeline
plan.narrative: Implement the Ingestion Node: load .md files (primary) and .epub files (secondary), detect chapters via chapter-NNN.md naming convention, build hierarchical summaries (chapter > act > global), chunk text, and index into LanceDB. Auto-detect file vs. directory input. Epub conversion uses ebooklib + stdlib xml.etree.ElementTree. Traces: FR-2, FR-6, FR-7, FR-13, NFR-1, NFR-3.

items.title: Markdown loader
items.narrative: Load .md files, detect chapter boundaries from chapter-NNN.md filenames. Sort by filename. Handle single file and directory inputs. FR-2, FR-6.

items.title: Epub loader
items.narrative: Load .epub via ebooklib, extract XHTML content, convert to plain text via stdlib xml.etree.ElementTree. Secondary priority. FR-7.

items.title: Hierarchical summarizer
items.narrative: Two-pass architecture Pass 1: build chapter summaries, group into act summaries, produce global summary. Store in LangGraph shared state. FR-6, NFR-1.

items.title: LanceDB indexing
items.narrative: Chunk text, generate embeddings, index chunks + summaries into LanceDB under .ghostreader/. FR-13.
